Breakout Baby | Baby's First Step

A downloadable game


BREAKOUT BABY is a Pac-Man–infused horror roguelike that rewards mastery of its mechanics and precise execution as you progress from floor to floor. Every step — every turn of the corner — matters. One slip-up and it’s all over, for you and your baby. Be careful out there, and don’t forget your Go-Go Juice.

Collect all the pellets on a floor to gain access to the next, but be careful!
Your greed doesn’t go unnoticed.
The freaks are out to get you. Don't get too close, they bite.

Meet some new friends along the way and let them upgrade your abilities.
Don’t worry, they’re all very nice. Remember to say thank you!

Collect baby supplies like rattles, pacifiers and iPads for powerful effects.
You will need them.

Keep close watch on your baby to gain information on enemy positions.
Shake your baby awake when necessary.

Why not?

Also, here's the dev. Please pat his head.
